mapping_policy: Observed exact own-root/TMP project or target/Python executable only; no generic home redaction or numeric/data normalization. Private inverse remains outside packet.
native_archive_policy: Native-v2 bytes are read from root sealed copy excluding its absent app bundle, retaining original logical case paths and actor raw hashes. Bundle identities are separately privately checked from original bundle, never copied.
reduced_return_coverage: Five native-v2 and one old native inventory return intentionally reduce /result; all pair metadata remain. These are not raw/full return content certificates.
sidecars: Two original TEMP2/.126 sidecar JSON files preserve exact bytes after whole-document schema/expected-data and privacy checks; force-add paths in BINDINGS/HANDOFF.
current_hero: Preview image is unchanged current own Harbor REST arrangement only; no new drape or quality/physics pass.
old_failures: Original5950 Return revision3-vs2 and four exact MCP color JSON mismatches stay failed; successor acceptance never regrades them.
native_limit: Bounded workflow supported with remaining gaps, not full frozen PLAN/contract; no explicit print-disclosure proof, old.12 Redo after Cancel runtime-unproven, TEMP2 autosave persistence exists.
publication_status: Private staging, root tracking/clean-checkout replay required

portable_adapter.classification: New static orchestration only, never a frozen original or native/product replay
portable_adapter.local_support_copy_reason: Original frozen evaluator eagerly imports svg_checker_frozen.py and pins that filename; exact source is kept to preserve unchanged frozen import/verification semantics.
portable_adapter.scope: Actual new saved file grading plus archived transcript/snapshot comparison; old classifications unchanged; no UI/producer/physics/Cargo/network.
portable_adapter.snapshot_policy: Raw snapshot hashes/sizes are compared to original provenance; safe public filename/content derivatives are separately compared to declared public hashes/sizes. No snapshot or case data is regraded/rewritten.
